title: sorghum roxburghii var. jucundum
intro: Sorghum roxburghii var. jucundum, commonly known as Chinese sorghum, is a plant species in the Sorghum genus. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Chinese sorghum include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues, among others. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
